strings: m_c rambles about visions of StarClan and the end of the world, despite {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates' reassurance.

m_c refuses to see r_c, citing a series of events that never happened. {PRONOUN/m_c/poss/CAP} erratic behavior may be a sign of psychosis.
